title: Adjudicate Norway amendment targets Lovdata declares but the index never binds

sections: F-10 — The index ignores Lovdata's declared-target field

objective: Store Lovdata's declared-target list on the index entry and emit one typed blocking adjudication per act whose bound base_ids do not cover it. Measure only: no new binding, no op change, no scoreboard movement. READ notes/norway-batches/contracts/02-declared-target-binding-coverage.brief.md IN FULL BEFORE ACTING — it carries the binding detail for every item below.
preflightChecks: NOAmendmentIndexEntry.base_ids in src/lawvm/norway/index.py is built from the grouped op list only.
src/lawvm/norway/grafter.py reads the changesToDocuments dd class inside _iter_unstructured_no_change_groups.
That grafter block reads the li descendants and normalizes each through normalize_lovdata_refid.
That grafter block sets default_base_id to the sole declared ref when exactly one is declared.
No file under src/lawvm/norway/index.py reads changesToDocuments.
normalize_lovdata_refid maps both lov date-number and lov date to no/lov ids.
normalize_lovdata_refid returns None for a forskrift ref and for the literal null.
No corpus law id has the no/lov date form without a trailing number.
parse_header_value in src/lawvm/norway/sources.py returns an XPath string() flattening.
parse_header_value on changesToDocuments returns the declared ids concatenated with no separator.
NOAmendmentIndex in src/lawvm/norway/index.py declares a diagnostics list field.
NOAmendmentIndex.to_dict uses asdict and NOAmendmentIndex.from_dict enumerates entry fields by name.
src/lawvm/norway/index.py emits diagnostic_detail with blocking True and quirks_disposition RECORD.
diagnostic_detail in src/lawvm/core/diagnostic_records.py has no role parameter.
diagnostic_detail in src/lawvm/core/diagnostic_records.py has no default_enforcement parameter.
FINDING_REGISTRY in src/lawvm/core/observation_registry.py contains no no_ rule codes.
No file under src/lawvm/norway/ imports observation_registry.
Every no_ rule id emitted under src/lawvm/norway/ has a _NO_RULE_SPECS catalog entry.
tests/test_spec_ledger_no_catalog.py runs on shard tools_cli_debug.
2942 of 3089 amendment artifacts carry a changesToDocuments block, and every such block is non-empty.
2941 of those blocks contain at least one lov-form target; no/lovtid/2021-06-18-115 declares only a forskrift.
Declared li payloads total 8651: 8535 lov date-number, 109 lov date, 6 forskrift, 1 null.
test_shard.sh affected for the five contract paths reports norway and tools_cli_debug.
requirements: READ notes/norway-batches/contracts/02-declared-target-binding-coverage.brief.md IN FULL BEFORE ACTING — it carries the binding detail for every item below.
Extract the existing changesToDocuments reader from grafter.py into ONE shared helper in sources.py; call it from grafter and index. Behavior-preserving.
Do NOT reuse parse_header_value (string() flattening yields one separator-free token). Do NOT write a new id normalizer; reuse normalize_lovdata_refid. Pin both in tests.
Bucket the 109 non-resolving 'lov/<date>' ids apart from real unbound targets.
Settle block-presence in code and test names: 2942 carry a block, 147 none, 2941 hold a lov-form target. no/lovtid/2021-06-18-115 is forskrift-only.
Add a declared-targets field to NOAmendmentIndexEntry with a default; extend from_dict with .get for backward compatibility.

Emit rule_id 'no_amendment_index_declared_target_unbound', family 'source_pathology', phase 'acquisition', blocking=True, strict_disposition='block', quirks_disposition=RECORD, into NOAmendmentIndex.diagnostics.
Detail carries source_id, declared count, bound count, sorted unbound ids.
Add the _NO_RULE_SPECS entry; scope its authority claim to the index, not the frontend.
Test no/lovtid/2022-12-20-115 (14 declared, 6 bound, 8 named), a fully-covered act emitting NO adjudication, and the separator trap.
invariants: base_ids stays derived solely from extracted ops; none added, removed, or reordered.
The grafter's sole-declared-ref default_base_id is PRE-EXISTING and preserved exactly.
n_ops unchanged; no op created, dropped, retargeted, or reordered.
Scoreboard at 2026-07-10 stays 12 consistent / 8 divergent / 0 error, per-law counts byte-identical.
The 147 block-less acts and the forskrift-only act neither raise nor emit a false adjudication.
Existing index diagnostics keep their rule ids, blocking flags, and dispositions.
Every no_* rule id under src/lawvm/norway/ has a _NO_RULE_SPECS entry.
The norway and tools_cli_debug shards pass.
exclusions: Fixing extraction so a declared target binds. A patch that newly binds a target violates the contract.
The bulk-rename list grammar (F-10 family 1) — separate batch, gated behind W-7.
Changing or extending the grafter's default_base_id rule.
Ledger and progress updates: the human apply step.
stopConditions: A declared payload outside the measured closed set: stop, record the counter-example.
from_dict cannot stay backward-compatible: stop; silent migration is out of scope.
Any replay output or divergence count moves: stop, the declared list has leaked into binding authority.
reviewFocus: READ notes/norway-batches/contracts/02-declared-target-binding-coverage.brief.md IN FULL BEFORE ACTING — it carries the binding detail for every item below. Judge the patch against it, not against these summaries.

Authority leakage is the central risk. Confirm no declared id reaches base_ids, op construction, or target resolution through anything ADDED, including fallback branches. The grafter ALREADY binds from a sole declared ref: the question is whether this widens it.
Confirm the grafter block was EXTRACTED, not copied, and normalize_lovdata_refid reused, not reimplemented. Two copies diverge.
Confirm the helper reads <li> elements, not the string() flattening.
Confirm the 109 non-resolving ids are bucketed apart from real unbound targets.
Confirm the no-gap case is tested and passes; if every act emits an adjudication the check is vacuous.
Confirm the 147 block-less acts, the forskrift-only act, and the literal 'null' item neither raise nor invent a target.
Confirm the _NO_RULE_SPECS entry exists in the siblings voice, and the to_dict/from_dict round-trip.

uv run ty check src/lawvm/norway/sources.py src/lawvm/norway/grafter.py src/lawvm/norway/index.py src/lawvm/tools/spec_ledger_no_catalog.py tests/test_norway_index.py

instructions: uv run lawvm no-verify-scan --limit 50 --as-of 2026-07-10 — MUST still be 12/8/0. Any movement: revert, do not accept.
uv run lawvm no-divergence no/lov/2015-05-12-27 --as-of 2026-07-10 — still 5 MISMATCHes plus the OPS_MISSING.
uv run python scripts/probes/no_declared_target_coverage.py — reconcile against 4088 across 1245 acts; explain differences, do not tune.
Adjudication present and blocking for no/lovtid/2022-12-20-115, absent for a fully-bound act.
Update the ledger and see notes/norway-batches/contracts/02-declared-target-binding-coverage.brief.md for the full list.
